description: One package from npm, PyPI or Packagist: latest version, description, declared licence, repository, homepage, deprecation or yanked status, version count, first and last publish date, declared dependencies of the latest release, and the OSV advisories that match the latest version. With source links, retrieval time and the changes YRUZ observed since its previous look. Price: 0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"deps_get_package"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/deps/package?ecosystem=npm&name=express
